thread:
mira: heads up, seeing controller-manager leader election flips in eu-west1 during last GPU pool scaleout
sam: saw same, timeline?
mira: ~09:12 UTC — burst of node attaches, NAT gateway logs show ephemeral port exhaustion and many connections TIME_WAIT
anika: oh. do we have logs from proxy? any 502/504 spikes?
mira: yes, apiserver proxy reported 'too many open connections' around 09:12. snippets:
```text
proxy: accept() failed: EMFILE
apiserver: 502 response to kcm-heartbeat
```
charlie: controller-manager keeps losing leader because renew calls timeout
sam: that matches. leader-lease renew hitting apiserver and failing due to proxy backlog
mira: consequence: controllers restart loops, pod churn, GPU attach queue grows
infra-bot: alert: nat-gateway-conn-exhaustion: 600 events in 5m
anika: quick mitigation: increase NAT ephemeral port range & conn tracking? also tune kube-proxy conn reuse
charlie: can we set kube-controller-manager --leader-elect-lease-duration to higher temporarily? reduces flip frequency
sam: +1 but longer lease delays failover during real outage. do both: short-term lease bump + infra patch
mira: will open infra ticket for NAT scaling and proxy limit bump
mira: ticket #INC-4627 (created)
mira: patch proposal:
```yaml
- increase nat ephemeral range to 32768-65535
- bump conntrack timeout for ESTABLISHED
- enable HTTP keepalive for proxy->apiserver
- temporary: controller-manager --leader-elect-lease-duration=20s --renew-deadline=12s
```
anika: benchmark needed for keepalive change. may break long-running streaming calls?
charlie: streaming unaffected if keepalive works; main issue is socket churn from attach/detach loop
sam: also look at GPU attach retries backoff and controller rate limiting
mira: agree. I'll coordinate with node-team to gate attach bursts (stagger attaches over 30s)
anika: can we add a quick alert rule: apiserver proxy queue > 80% and nat ephemeral usage > 90%
sam: yes, adding now. ping once done
sam: added alert: APISERVER_PROXY_BACKLOG and NAT_EPHEMERAL_HIGH
charlie: TL;DR: root cause NAT port exhaustion from cold GPU attach storm -> proxy saturation -> leader renew failures -> controller flip -> churn. Plan: nat/conntrack + proxy keepalive + temporary lease increase + attach-stagger + alerts
mira: I'll runplaybook and update incident doc
infra-bot: incident created: INC-4627 | owner: mira | severity: P2
sam: thanks, will follow up on rollout tests
anika: note for later: consider per-region NAT autoscaling and faster NAT failover
mira: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
